typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	FileLocation as string (),
	FileName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Member Identifier Modifier} as string,
		{Member Identifier} as string,
		{Segment Identifier} as string,
		{Pharmacy  Claim ID} as string,
		{Pharmacy Claim Modifier} as string,
		Quantity as string,
		{Date Filled} as timestamp,
		NDC as string,
		{Days Supply} as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [Segment Identifier]       ,[Pharmacy  Claim ID]       ,[Pharmacy Claim Modifier]       ,[Member Identifier]       ,[Member Identifier Modifier]       ,[NDC]       ,[Date Filled]       ,[Days Supply]       ,[Quantity]   FROM [DATA_EXCHANGE].EXTRACT.[PHARMACY_EXTRACT_OPTUM]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Member_Identifier_Modifier as string,
		Member_Identifier as string,
		Segment_Identifier as string,
		Pharmacy__Claim_ID as string,
		Pharmacy_Claim_Modifier as string,
		Quantity as integer,
		Date_Filled as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		NDC as string,
		Days_Supply as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Member_Identifier_Modifier = {Member Identifier Modifier},
		Member_Identifier = {Member Identifier},
		Segment_Identifier = {Segment Identifier},
		Pharmacy__Claim_ID = {Pharmacy  Claim ID},
		Pharmacy_Claim_Modifier = {Pharmacy Claim Modifier},
		Quantity,
		Date_Filled = {Date Filled},
		NDC,
		Days_Supply = {Days Supply})) ~> FlatFileDestination
